assistant|strut_your_mutt_participating_: Strut Your Mutt partners include LA Animal Services, The Humane Society of the United States, and ASPCA Los Angeles
assistant|strut_your_mutt_auction_items: Silent auction at Strut Your Mutt features pet-themed packages, exclusive experiences, luxury items, unique services, and autographed items

assistant|strut_your_mutt_fundraising: Strut Your Mutt participants can fundraise individually or form teams, set up personal fundraising pages, and top fundraisers receive prizes and recognition
